description: This file defines middleware functions for security-related HTTP headers and CORS configuration in an Express.js application. It includes functions for setting up CORS with dynamic whitelist based on environment variables, helmet middleware with relaxed CSP, and a rate limiter for dashboard endpoints.

methods.name: toOriginMaybe
methods.description: Normalizes a URL-like string to an origin (scheme://host[:port]) or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: corsMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express middleware for handling CORS with a dynamic whitelist based on environment variables.

methods.name: helmetMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns a Helmet middleware with relaxed Content Security Policy and cross-origin resource policy.

methods.name: rateLimiter
methods.description: Creates and returns a rate limiting middleware for dashboard endpoints, configurable via environment variables.
